Alger, 7 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Des: Algiers, August 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Students from the Mohamed Seddik Ben Yahia University have designed innovative technical solutions leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and 5G technology to optimize the operations of businesses and public institutions. Their projects aim to strengthen operational efficiency and local digital sovereignty.
Plateformes intelligentes à base de dial: Smart platforms based on the Algerian dialect for digital sovereignty
d’intelligence artificielle, Soumia Lake: in artificial intelligence, Soumia Lakehal, presented a model for an Algerian digital platform designed to assist institutions and businesses in contact with citizens. This system relies on an intelligent assistant capable of speaking in the Algerian dialect, offering an alternative to foreign solutions unsuited to the local linguistic context.
Selon ses explications, cet outil permet: According to her explanations, this tool allows any company to generate a personalized assistant in a few minutes from its own documents and internal information. The user can interact with this assistant in the Algerian dialect, standard Arabic, French, or English, while the data remains stored locally and protected. This approach marks a step forward toward digital sovereignty, she emphasized.
Interaction intuitive avec les données s: Intuitive data interaction without technical skills
Un second projet, développé par Chaïma B: A second project, developed by Chaïma Bensouilah, offers a solution allowing employees to query their databases in natural language. Queries such as "what are this month's sales?" or "who are the top customers?" are transformed into secure searches, analyzed instantly, and returned without transmitting data to third parties.
Cette plateforme conserve les données su: This platform keeps data on local servers, authorizes the extraction and rapid analysis of information, thereby improving productivity. It also reduces the time, effort, and costs associated with decision-making processes.
IA et 5G au service de l’efficacité admi: AI and 5G at the service of administrative and economic efficiency
Le Professeur Zenir Mohamed-Nadjib, enca: Professor Zenir Mohamed-Nadjib, supervising these projects, specified that the goal is to design AI algorithms compatible with the local dialect. He believes that the integration of these technologies into the operations of institutions—such as tax or customs services—could significantly accelerate the processing of files, such as permit validation or merchants' tax management.
Abderazak Laarioui, de la faculté des sc: Abderazak Laarioui, from the Faculty of Economic Sciences, highlighted the role of students in providing concrete technical solutions to real-world challenges. He emphasized that AI and 5G constitute major levers for the economic transition in Algeria, by improving industrial productivity and optimizing strategic sectors like energy and smart agriculture.
Applications sectorielles de la 5G : san: Sectoral applications of 5G: healthcare, agriculture, and industry
Dans le domaine de la santé, la 5G facil: In the healthcare sector, 5G facilitates remote medical consultations, the transmission of high-precision images, and connectivity between hospitals and health centers across the wilayas. These innovations reduce patient transfers, save time and costs, and even enable remote surgical interventions.
Pour l’agriculture, cette technologie pe: For agriculture, this technology enables the use of sensors and smart irrigation systems to streamline water consumption and increase yields. In industry, it improves the monitoring of production lines, thus contributing to better competitiveness.
